title: Adobe and Google expand strategic AI partnership across creative tools suite
summary: Adobe and Google expand strategic AI partnership across creative software suite
detailed: New Delhi (ANI): Adobe and Google on Wednesday announced an expansion of their strategic partnership to integrate Google's advanced artificial intelligence (AI) models into Adobe's creative and productivity tools, including Photoshop, Acrobat, Premiere and Adobe Express.
The partnership, announced at Adobe MAX, will also bring Adobe's tools to Google's platforms, including Gmail, Google Drive, Gemini, Gemini Enterprise and AI Mode in Google Search.
The companies will further expand Adobe's existing integrations with Gemini and Gemini Enterprise, allowing users to enhance images, customise designs and work with PDFs within AI conversations.

Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said, "By further connecting our respective platforms, we are giving creators and enterprise teams a powerful, integrated environment to turn their ideas into high-impact content."
Meanwhile, Adobe and Google DeepMind will collaborate to develop new AI-powered image editing capabilities, beginning with Photoshop.
sentences: New Delhi (ANI): Adobe and Google on Wednesday announced an expansion of their strategic partnership to integrate Google's advanced artificial intelligence (AI) models into Adobe's creative and productivity tools, including Photoshop, Acrobat, Premiere and Adobe Express.
The partnership, announced at Adobe MAX, will also bring Adobe's tools to Google's platforms, including Gmail, Google Drive, Gemini, Gemini Enterprise and AI Mode in Google Search.
Adobe will also integrate Google's AI models into Acrobat to help users edit PDFs through conversational commands, understand documents and create presentations and reports.
The companies will further expand Adobe's existing integrations with Gemini and Gemini Enterprise, allowing users to enhance images, customise designs and work with PDFs within AI conversations.

Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said, "By further connecting our respective platforms, we are giving creators and enterprise teams a powerful, integrated environment to turn their ideas into high-impact content."
Meanwhile, Adobe and Google DeepMind will collaborate to develop new AI-powered image editing capabilities, beginning with Photoshop.
The companies are exploring technology that could enable near-real-time image editing through text prompts, allowing users to make changes and choose between different versions of images.
The expanded agreement builds on the companies' existing collaboration across AI, creative software and digital productivity.
This report was published from a wire feed.
